scope: One Watson prototype with separate 15-card front and profile banks sharing a bounded 3D gait. Full cast and story integration remain incomplete.

joint_study.scope: Front-view neutral, modest arm bend, isolated foot lift, exploded cards, and joint overlays.

walking_study.scope: FRONT / STRAIGHT ON and SIDE / PROFILE use distinct artwork banks. COMPARE / BOTH VIEWS shares gait/frame/scale in orthographic inspection, desktop columns and phone stacking.

coordinates.cards: Source pixels; left/right mean viewer sides in the rest master; rest delta rotation is zero.
coordinates.gait: [x,y,z]; x lateral with left negative, y up, z forward; world floor is defined explicitly.
coordinates.source_geometry_reference: manifest.json: source_geometry; use alpha bounds and actual pivots, not padded PNG dimensions.
coordinates.calibration_basis: Registered artwork joints and profile-informed logical ankle; not independently measured anatomical centers.
coordinates.profile_cards: Source pixels; near maps to gait.left, far to gait.right; source silhouette height1477px.

geometry_rules.front_joint_lab: Use manifest rectangles at their original dimensions and inherited pivot rotations.
geometry_rules.walking_projection: Fixed registered 3D rig endpoints and camera projection determine foreshortening; no cosmetic per-part length/width fitting.
geometry_rules.transverse_card_scale: One native source-pixel/world scale, with camera perspective applied consistently.
geometry_rules.bilateral_calibration: Small left/right registered card-segment differences are averaged once into scalar lengths; no animated remeasurement and no anatomical-ground-truth claim.
geometry_rules.joint_backing: Solid concealed overlap attached to its owning segment; retain sufficient material through the required range.
geometry_rules.visible_hardware: One owner per joint; no brad-sized transparency holes in the digital art.

ground_and_connection_rules.stance_anchor: Fixed world coordinate for the duration of its stance event.
ground_and_connection_rules.active_contact: Heel, flat, or toe contact must remain on the floor without sliding.
ground_and_connection_rules.root_travel: Driven by traveled distance; phase derives from distance/strideLength.
ground_and_connection_rules.reach_adjustment: Report root.reachAdjustment explicitly; never compensate by moving a planted foot or changing a fixed registered rig segment length.
ground_and_connection_rules.visible_connection: Rendered shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle must read as connected; coincident pivots alone are insufficient.
ground_and_connection_rules.visible_grounding: Painted heel/sole contact must agree with the model contact; numerical contact checks alone are insufficient.
ground_and_connection_rules.walk_review: Inspect a complete loop with fixed ground references for foot drift, weight transfer, clearance, continuity, and self-occlusion.
ground_and_connection_rules.anatomical_claim: A numerical fixed-length pass certifies only the registered model constraints; it is not anatomical or natural-motion certification.

view_bank.references: locomotion/existing_direction_references/ contains eight unmodified prior Watson PNGs, labelled by observed screen direction.
view_bank.view_change_rule: Select the matching bank. Camera view, character facing and travel are separate. Front artwork is never substituted for a profile bank.

foot_depth_calibration.basis: Observed flat far-profile shoe landmarks at the shared 1477px source height.

controller_mechanics: Front and side projection of one 3D skeleton
Soft-knee reach limits and lower swing clearance
Separate body-orientation channels and phased elbow/wrist motion
demonstrated.front_walk_art: Existing front cards run with a distinct lower logical ankle; changing heel/sole and foreshortened surfaces remain limited.
demonstrated.profile_walk_art: Separate 15-part screen-right profile bank, native footwear/hand aspect, near/far layering and bounded gait rendering.
demonstrated.view_controls: Nine passing actual-app headless script/event checks; see locomotion/proofs/view-controls-validation.json.

not_completed: Finished natural-looking front and profile locomotion approval
Turns, starts/stops, true sidesteps and curved-path contact planning
Full expression library in this prototype
known_front_art_limits: Painted boot contact may disagree visually with the grounded heel proxy at heel strike.
Frontal texture on a foreshortened swing shin can read as telescoping.
Flat cards cannot reveal newly exposed heel, sole, palm-back, or rear surfaces.
Whole-card depth ordering cannot resolve all self-occlusion.
Constructed hidden overlap texture is not finished exposed artwork.
claim_boundary: Mechanical consistency, distinct view banks and bounded artwork connectivity do not establish independent anatomical accuracy, a completed natural walk, or a fixed production cast.

locomotion_ankle_registration.measurement_kind: Manually registered profile artwork, transferred to the front source at the same silhouette scale.
locomotion_ankle_registration.separation: The y1330 shaft mount remains a card attachment. The lower logical ankle is a distinct moving-foot joint. Front PNGs are unchanged.

known_profile_art_limits: Profile illustration has slight three-quarter details in face/jacket; silhouette and limbs face screen-right.
Source boot brad is a mechanical attachment and not a measured anatomical ankle.
Source art is one contact pose; broad movement may reveal reconstructed hidden material.

Canonical shoe dimensions now come from the observed far profile shoe; native near/far profiles still differ by about12.5px in attachment-to-sole height and about4px in length. The renderer preserves shoe aspect and reports residual attachment error.
historical_walking_evidence: locomotion/history/pre_relaxed_walk/ contains the prior gait; locomotion/history/pre_profile_update/ predates profile-informed ankle registration. Neither is current motion validation.

motion_revision.scope: Bounded animation revision; natural-walk approval remains incomplete.
motion_revision.requested_hip_height: sourceHipHeight - 0.013H - 0.009H*cos(4*pi*cycle - 0.2*pi); reach adjustment can lower it further
motion_revision.body_orientation: gait.bodyOrientation contains pelvisPitch/Roll/Yaw, torsoPitch/Roll/Yaw and headPitch/Roll/Yaw in radians; subtle phased elbow flexion and wrist lag are also applied.
motion_revision.measurement_claim: Animation tuning values; not universal physiological measurements or natural-motion certification.

profile_head_registration.attachment: Head neck attachment follows the torso-transformed source collar.
profile_head_registration.interpretation: Effectively zero numerical gap; no head-scale anisotropy in the sampled cycle. This is a registration check, not natural-motion approval.
